title: Add a sales report for a range of days
description: Adds GET /api/admin/sales?from=&to= for admins: the number and total of paid orders placed from the start of `from` to the end of `to` (UTC days, YYYY-MM-DD). Includes tests and a README entry.

comments.issue: `to` is parsed from the `from` parameter (copy-paste), so `to` is ignored: every report covers only the first day, and a missing or bad `to` is not refused.
